study type: Prospective cohort study with diagnostic marker evaluation
exposure: Uterine artery Doppler peaks of systolic velocity
cohort: The study included 125 pregnant patients referred to an outpatient pregnancy clinic due to symptoms of pregnancy complications or attending a high-risk hospital clinic for close surveillance.
finding: Arterial stiffness can serve as a major marker to differentiate PE (with/without IUGR) from pure IUGR near delivery, while TNFa can differentiate iatrogenic early PTD from other complications of pregnancy and term IUGR.
cross-section timing: At the time of enrolment, near delivery
gest_age: Subgroups included deliveries <34 weeks' gestation for PE, IUGR, PE+IUGR, and PTD, with unaffected pregnancies delivering at term.
